claims: Creator is Ben Gusberg, Stanford founder of an AI startup that has raised $4 million
Ng's course teaches what agents are, how they plan and use tools

how_to_steps: Take Andrew Ng's Agentic AI course on deeplearning.ai for the basics
Do the first six lessons (explanations and videos) of Microsoft's AI Agents for Beginners before the setup-heavy lessons
Take Hugging Face's AI Agents course to build fuller agents with tools
Pick one recurring pain point in your life and build an agent that solves it
